┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │  VaultXPresale                vaultx.io  ©2025            │
 ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │  ETH-denominated fixed-rate presale for VaultX (VTX).     │
 │                                                            │
 │  States                                                    │
 │    PENDING  — before start time                            │
 │    ACTIVE   — accepting deposits                           │
 │    SUCCESS  — hard cap reached OR ended above soft cap     │
 │    FAILED   — ended below soft cap / force-failed          │
 │                                                            │
 │  On SUCCESS  → buyers call claimTokens()                   │
 │  On FAILED   → buyers call claimRefund()                   │
 │  On SUCCESS  → owner calls withdrawFunds()                 │
 └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

@notice Emergency: force the presale into FAILED state.
         Enables all depositors to reclaim their ETH.
@notice Claim your VTX allocation after a successful presale.
@notice Reclaim your ETH deposit after a failed presale.
@notice Withdraw all raised ETH after a successful presale.

@notice Recover unsold or residual VTX tokens after presale ends.
         Only tokens beyond pending buyer claims can be recovered.

params._softCap: Minimum raise for success (must be ≤ hardCap)

claimRefund().notice: Reclaim your ETH deposit after a failed presale.

claimTokens().notice: Claim your VTX allocation after a successful presale.

deposit().notice: Purchase VTX tokens by sending ETH.         Any ETH that would exceed your wallet cap or the hard cap         is automatically refunded.

forceFailPresale().notice: Emergency: force the presale into FAILED state.         Enables all depositors to reclaim their ETH.

initialize(address,uint256,uint256,uint2.notice: Configure and activate the presale. One-time call by owner.

recoverUnsoldTokens().notice: Recover unsold or residual VTX tokens after presale ends.         Only tokens beyond pending buyer claims can be recovered.

withdrawFunds().notice: Withdraw all raised ETH after a successful presale.
